paragraphs.text: Chris L'Etoile is a former Narrative Design Coordinator at Wizards of the Coast . He worked for the company between March 2016 and February 2017. Chris is a writer who specializes in IP development, worldbuilding , and quest design skills for single-player and multiplayer roleplaying games. He considers his particular strengths to be non-linear (“choose your own adventure”) narrative and writing dialogue for voiceover.

Working in the games industry since 1990, he has created two console RPGs ( Mass Effect , Mass Effect 2 ); one PC RPG ( Dragon Age: Origins ); one console DLC pack ( Mass Effect: Bring Down the Sky ); two MMORPGs ( Asheron’s Call , Asheron’s Call 2: Fallen Kings ); one retail MMORPG expansion pack ( Asheron’s Call: Dark Majesty ) and one MOBA ( Dawngate ).

For Magic: The Gathering , L'Etoile contributed to Magic Story for Kaladesh and Aether Revolt . He also participated in narrative design and plotting for story blocks Kaladesh (2016), Amonkhet (2017), and Ixalan (2017), and contributed to setting development for Dominaria 25th Anniversary (2018) and War of the Spark (2019).
